notes: Local web/dev servers: logs and regenerable caches under $HOME or user-writable Homebrew prefixes. TLS/CA material (mkcert CAROOT, Caddy data certs, Valet Certificates, Traefik/ACME, MinIO certs) is report-only and never default-delete. Document roots (htdocs, MAMP/XAMPP site trees, MinIO object data) are report-only. Prefer contents-only deletes with age floors. System /Library and bare /Applications package roots may be filtered by merge never-touch; still listed for inventory. Excludes project source trees, Docker image layers (separate virt batch), and full DB data dirs.

rules.name: Nginx Homebrew access/error logs
rules.description: Access and error logs for Homebrew nginx (Apple Silicon and Intel prefixes).
rules.notes: Default brew nginx log dir. Regenerable; rotate/age before wipe if debugging.

rules.name: Nginx proxy/client temp and cache dirs
rules.description: proxy_temp, client_body_temp, fastcgi_temp, scgi_temp, uwsgi_temp and optional proxy_cache_path under Homebrew var or user cache.
rules.notes: Ephemeral body/proxy temps and disk caches. Safe while nginx is stopped or with age filter.

rules.name: Apache httpd Homebrew logs
rules.description: Homebrew apache2/httpd error and access logs.
rules.notes: ErrorLog/CustomLog targets for brew httpd. Not system /var/log/apache2.

rules.name: OpenResty Homebrew logs
rules.description: OpenResty/nginx-style logs under Homebrew var (often shared nginx log path or dedicated openresty).
rules.notes: openresty/brew formula; may also write to var/log/nginx depending on conf.

rules.name: PHP-FPM Homebrew logs
rules.description: php-fpm master/pool logs from Homebrew PHP (Valet-compatible paths included).
rules.notes: Only php-fpm log globs; do not wipe entire var/log. Known disk hogs on Mac brew PHP.

rules.name: Caddy data directory (certs, report-only)
rules.description: Caddy storage for TLS certs, keys, OCSP staples. Not a cache.
rules.notes: Official docs: data dir must not be treated as cache. Purge forces re-issuance and downtime risk.

rules.name: Caddy config autosave (report-only)
rules.description: Last active Caddy config (autosave.json) and config dir for --resume.
rules.notes: macOS often co-locates config under Application Support/Caddy; Linux uses ~/.config/caddy.

rules.name: Caddy HTTP/asset cache dirs
rules.description: Optional user-level Caddy or reverse-proxy disk caches outside the official data store.
rules.notes: Only true cache roots. Never point at Application Support/Caddy data (certs).

rules.name: Traefik ACME/certs storage (report-only)
rules.description: Local Traefik acme.json and certificate storage under user config homes.
rules.notes: ACME account keys and issued certs. Path is user-configured; inventory only.

rules.name: Traefik logs and access logs
rules.description: Traefik access/error logs when written under user log/cache dirs.
rules.notes: Do not include acme.json paths here.

rules.name: Laravel Valet nginx/php-fpm logs
rules.description: Valet user logs for nginx and PHP-FPM under ~/.config/valet/Log.
rules.notes: Docs: fpm-php.www.log and nginx-error.log. Legacy ~/.valet still seen on old installs.

rules.name: Laravel Valet TLS certificates (report-only)
rules.description: Per-site certificates generated by valet secure (mkcert-backed).
rules.notes: Not logs. Re-run valet secure after intentional wipe. Do not default-delete.

rules.name: Laravel Herd nginx/php-fpm/mail logs
rules.description: Herd service logs (nginx, php-fpm, optional Herd Pro mail).
rules.notes: Official: ~/Library/Application Support/Herd/Log. Debug: Herd_Debug.log when launched with --enable-logfile.

rules.name: Laravel Herd caches and temp
rules.description: Herd-related caches under Library/Caches and Application Support temp trees.
rules.notes: Do not delete Herd/bin (PHP/composer binaries) or Herd/config.

rules.name: Laravel Herd binaries (report-only)
rules.description: Downloaded PHP versions and tool binaries shipped with Herd.
rules.notes: Large re-download; not a disposable cache.

rules.name: MAMP/MAMP PRO logs
rules.description: Apache, nginx, MySQL, PHP logs for MAMP stack.
rules.notes: Default MAMP logs under /Applications/MAMP/logs. Merge may drop /Applications roots; user Library paths remain.

rules.name: MAMP tmp and cache
rules.description: MAMP temp, opcache, and Application Support caches (not databases).
rules.notes: Exclude db/mysql* data directories.

rules.name: MAMP htdocs document root (report-only)
rules.description: User site files under MAMP htdocs. Never auto-delete.
rules.notes: User content, not cache. Inventory size only.

rules.name: XAMPP logs and temp
rules.description: XAMPP for macOS logs and temp under xamppfiles.
rules.notes: ApacheFriends XAMPP macOS layout. Stop services before wipe.

rules.name: XAMPP htdocs document root (report-only)
rules.description: Default XAMPP DocumentRoot with user sites.
rules.notes: User content. Report-only.

rules.name: Local WP (Flywheel) app logs
rules.description: Local by Flywheel / Local WP application and lightning logs.
rules.notes: App diagnostics; site-level logs may also live under per-site folders outside this rule.

rules.name: Local WP cached WordPress zips
rules.description: Downloaded WordPress core archives cached by Local for new sites.
rules.notes: Regenerable on next site create. Not live site files.

rules.name: Local WP run nginx temps and aged logs
rules.description: Router/run tree temps and log files under Local/run (not mysql data or sockets).
rules.notes: Live run dir holds sockets/DB; only log/temp globs. Prefer sites stopped.

rules.name: Local WP lightning-services runtimes (report-only)
rules.description: Bundled PHP/MySQL/nginx service builds for Local sites.
rules.notes: Installed runtimes; large re-download. Not safe default clean.

rules.name: DDEV Mutagen sync data directory
rules.description: Global Mutagen data for DDEV file sync on macOS.
rules.notes: Docs: MUTAGEN_DATA_DIRECTORY. Prefer ddev mutagen reset / ddev poweroff first. Rebuilds sync state.

rules.name: DDEV global test/cache leftovers
rules.description: Regenerable global DDEV cache-like trees excluding config and project list.
rules.notes: Do not delete global_config.yaml, project_list.yaml, or commands/homeadditions.

rules.name: DDEV Traefik/mkcert router certs (report-only)
rules.description: Router certificates under global DDEV traefik certs (mkcert-generated).
rules.notes: Regenerated on ddev start but TLS trust breaks until then. Report-only.

rules.name: DDEV private binaries (report-only)
rules.description: Private mutagen/docker-buildx binaries under ~/.ddev/bin.
rules.notes: Re-downloaded by DDEV as needed; not junk by default.

rules.name: Lando cache and logs
rules.description: Lando userConfRoot cache, logs, and plugin install cache under ~/.lando.
rules.notes: lando config | grep userConfRoot for custom root. Plugins dir is medium/report if large.

rules.name: Lando global plugins (report-only)
rules.description: Globally installed Lando plugins under ~/.lando/plugins.
rules.notes: User-installed plugins; reinstall required after wipe.

rules.name: Docksal cache and logs
rules.description: Docksal global home cache/logs under ~/.docksal.
rules.notes: Project stacks live in Docker; this is host-side Docksal state only.

rules.name: Tilt dev caches and modules cache
rules.description: Tilt analytics, certs cache, and cached extension modules under macOS Application Support / Caches.
rules.notes: GitHub issues: rm Library/Caches/tilt-dev/certs for bad certs. Extensions also under Application Support.

rules.name: Tilt extension modules and helm cache
rules.description: Cached tilt_modules and .helm downloads under Application Support/tilt-dev.
rules.notes: Re-cloned on next tilt up. Keep config/api certs if present.

rules.name: Skaffold build and remote cache
rules.description: Default Skaffold artifact cache file dir and remote dependency cache.
rules.notes: CLI defaults: --cache-file $HOME/.skaffold/cache, --remote-cache-dir $HOME/.skaffold/remote-cache. Avoid wiping config.yaml if co-located without globs.

rules.name: Telepresence cache and daemon logs
rules.description: Telepresence user cache, daemon logs under ~/.cache/telepresence.
rules.notes: logs/connector.log etc. Version bumps may auto-clear stale cache entries.

rules.name: Telepresence config (report-only)
rules.description: Telepresence user configuration and connection state.
rules.notes: Config/identity; not disposable cache.

rules.name: Envoy local access/admin logs
rules.description: User-level Envoy log and hot-restart dirs when run outside containers.
rules.notes: Most Envoy usage is in-cluster; host paths only if local binary/dev sandbox used.

rules.name: istioctl local install leftovers
rules.description: istioctl client install tree and local debug dumps under home.
rules.notes: Docs put client at ~/.istioctl/bin. Mesh state is cluster-side; this is host CLI only.

rules.name: MinIO object data (report-only)
rules.description: Common local MinIO data directories and default config home. Object storage is user data.
rules.notes: minio server PATH is user-chosen; these are common local defaults only. Never auto-delete buckets.

rules.name: MinIO TLS certs dir (report-only)
rules.description: Default MinIO certs under ~/.minio/certs.
rules.notes: TLS material only. Do not treat as cache.

rules.name: mkcert CAROOT (report-only, never delete)
rules.description: mkcert local CA and issued certs. Explicitly not for deletion.
rules.notes: CAROOT holds rootCA.pem and keys. Deleting breaks local HTTPS trust for Valet/DDEV/Herd. Inventory only; never default clean.

rules.name: dnsmasq Homebrew logs (Valet/Herd adjacent)
rules.description: dnsmasq logs when installed via Homebrew for local *.test routing.
rules.notes: Often a single log file path; contents mode on parent if directory.

rules.name: Caddy process logs under Library/Logs
rules.description: Optional Caddy log files when log directive targets user Library/Logs.
rules.notes: Separate from data/config cert stores.

rules.name: User-prefix nginx logs under home
rules.description: Custom nginx builds or brew --prefix under home exporting logs.
rules.notes: Non-standard home installs.

rules.name: User-prefix Apache logs under home
rules.description: httpd logs for user-built or home-prefixed Apache.
rules.notes: Complements brew /opt paths for fully user-local stacks.
